criteria.criterion: P1 主IC: IC>0, NW t>=3, >=6/7 相位均值>0
P2 分年: 2022-2025 至少3年周均IC>0
P3 metrics子集: IC^M>0, t>=2, IC^M>=0.5*IC
P4 执行稳健: 01:00版同号且>=0.7*IC; 滞后1天版同号且>=0.5*IC
P5 标签稳健: 严格版同号且>=0.7*IC
E1 事件: beta_D1>0, 单侧p<=0.05, beta_D1>=2*mean c_rt
E2 消融: 各判定组 beta_k<=0.5*beta_D1 且 delta>0 (C3/C4 p_delta<=0.05; C12 点估计)
E3 事件分年: 2022-2025 至少3年 beta_D1>0
E4 尾部: 缩尾后 beta_D1>=mean c_rt; 去掉前5币后 beta_D1>0
E5 严格标签版 beta_D1 同号且>=0.7*beta_D1

kills.kill: K6 <=1整年为正, 或缩尾/去前5币 beta_D1<=0

holdout_guard:
* daily prices: perp_daily filtered at scan to date <= 2026-03-30 and in_holdout==False
  * funding settlements: ts <= 2026-03-31 00:00 UTC (asserted on every interval used)
  * 1h / 5m klines: open_time <= 2026-03-30 01:00 / 00:30 UTC
  * signal days d <= 2026-03-22 (h=7), d <= 2026-03-26 (h=3), d <= 2026-03-15 (h=14)
  * fwd_7d / fwd_7d_lv read only for d <= 2026-03-22, only to cross-check self-built labels
